title: Swordfish
author: Smurtzzz
selftext:
This is Swordfish, 2D-platformer / Brawler project.  
  
Join Gunnar and his swordfish companion on a rough adventure along the Norwegian coast. Hook, swing, and fight your way through a fishing village where something has gone very wrong.   
  
Try the demo: [https://rosebud.ai/play/mariners-harpoon-havoc](https://rosebud.ai/play/mariners-harpoon-havoc)  
  
I’d love specific feedback: what was fun, what felt clunky or confusing.  
Especially combat, movement, and the hook mechanic.   
  
Press P to pause, you can jump between checkpoints from the pause menu.

comments.author: KingofKingsofKingsof
comments.body: A nice idea with potential, but the execution needs to be way way better. Enemies have no walking animation. Backgrounds don't repeat correctly. Shadow is attached to the player when he jumps. With AI there is little excuse for this as the AI will do largely what you want it to do, but you need to work with it. Concentrate on getting a single play area right. Get the movement, the animations, and the core gameplay working right in this one section. Then build on it from there. Foundations first, rest of the game later.

comments.author: Longwashere
comments.body: Not good. Gives A.I games a bad rep. Please make it better before show casing

comments.body: I am so sick of people posting "games" that are generated by one-shot prompts

comments.author: BuildAnything4
comments.body: even before ai, I would say this project has such obvious visual flaws you should work out before putting it in front of people.  There's no excuse now that AI has made it easier than ever.

replies.author: Smurtzzz
replies.body: OK Thanks for your feedback, I'm aware of the lack of visual presentation at this moment. At this point I'm investigating if the game-loop and mechanics feels good, and if its worth keep developing.  But I see the visuals should be on point before sharing.
